text:
liam: Originating RC rc-20260410-fleet at artifact sha:beefcafe. Need a quick pin + readiness check. This includes a lightweight cache TTL change and a tiny model config tweak that targets dedicated pools. Quiet window 23:30-00:30 UTC. Who can sheriff?

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-20260410-fleet build OK. Unit/integration/smoke all green. Release notes staged: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20260410-fleet

zara: Quick question: is this changing the global cache TTL or only on dedicated inference nodes?

liam: scoped to dedicated pools via routing tag 'fleet-dedicated' only. config snippet: `cache.ttl.override = { scope: "fleet-dedicated" }`

ops-oncall: I'll cover the quiet window. Need commit sha, rollback artifact, and abort thresholds. Also set deadman timeout.

liam: commit sha: beefcafe. rollback artifact: sha:c0ffeeba (rc-stable). Abort thresholds: 1.5% error rate OR p99 latency +35% for 10m. Deadman timeout 30m.

qa-bot: Running preflight evals: rerank correctness and hallucination regression checks queued. ETA 12m. Canary harness ready.

release-manager: Note: this RC should be pinned in the artifact store under tag rc/fleet/20260410 after promotion. Please include changelog lines for ops and product.

deploy-bot: Promotion command (example):
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-20260410-fleet --artifact=sha:beefcafe \
  --canary-stages=2,20,100 --quiet-window=23:30-00:30UTC \
  --deadman=30m --notify=@ops-oncall --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20260410-fleet
```

zara: Request: start at 2% for 12m, then 20% for 18m, then full. Watch metric groups: rerank_exact_match, hallucination_rate, and token_cost.

ops-oncall: I'll watch dashboards and have escalation ready. If deadman triggers or thresholds exceeded, we'll abort and follow rollback playbook.

liam: Kicking promotion now. tagging @deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: ACTION by liam: scheduled promotion at 23:33 UTC. Canary: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Health checks: /health, token cost probe, and lightweight eval set each stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 1: 2% canary deploy started... done. Traffic routed to canary. Health: passing. Telemetry: no errors.

qa-bot: Canary smoke run: no critical diffs. rerank_exact_match delta -0.05% (within noise). hallucination_rate unchanged.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 20% traffic. Rolling update in progress... routing updated. Health: passing.

ops-oncall: Monitoring. p99 latency +12% but within abort threshold. error rate 0.4%. :ok_hand:

release-manager: reminder to pin artifact after final step. Also create release note entry for the TTL change and fleet tag.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across zones. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: Promotion finished. All regions at rc-20260410-fleet artifact sha:beefcafe. Post-deploy checks green.

qa-bot: Extended postdeploy evals running (30m). Initial indicators fine; small cost decrease observed due to TTL bump.

ops-oncall: Approving final state. Marking rollout stable. Deadman canceled.

liam: Thanks team. Pinning artifact to rc/fleet/20260410 and updating changelog.

release-manager: Done: artifact pinned and release notes published. Link: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20260410-fleet#changelog

deploy-bot: Postdeploy watch window active. If any regression meets abort criteria, a rollback ticket will be auto-created. Rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:c0ffeeba --reason="auto or manual rollback - rc-20260410-fleet"
```

zara: FYI noticed a tiny 0.2% drop in one rerank cohort. Opening a follow-up eval issue: https://go.internal/issue/EV-4602

liam: Thanks @zara — we'll triage EV-4602 in next patch unless it worsens. Keeping thread open for 24h to verify stability. :spiral_notepad:
